title: Get a permit for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. The council adopted the Kojonup local law with modifications (Gazette No. 51, 23 Mar 2004); the clause is quoted from that law as made. Amended later (Gazette No. 14, 27 Jan 2016); the amendments were not read. The council adopted the Exmouth local law with modifications (Gazette No. 51, 23 Mar 2004); the clause is quoted from that law as made. The adopting law modifies this clause, so the quoted words may differ.

assessment.summary: Advertising signs in public places need the council's permit.

marks.reason: A permit, fees and design rules for signs in public places.
